6ef057fd0a.q: What is the relationship between tax recapture and accelerated cost segregation when selling multifamily properties at a loss?
6ef057fd0a.a: When syndicators and GPs sell properties with no profit after using accelerated cost segregation and exhausting net operating losses, they face recapture taxation. Investors can be taxed on recapture at rates up to 37.5% even if they lost their entire capital, and recapture is split between 1231, 1250, and 1245 provisions.
